candidates.label: CoPatternContagion+
candidates.working_definition: Candidate copying/adoption over explicitly typed edges; popularity does not imply benefit
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Compare to ordinary threshold/diffusion models with held-out diffusion traces

candidates.label: CoExposurePath+
candidates.working_definition: A typed eligible directed route through which an object might be encountered
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Block/unblock edge and check receiver boundary

candidates.label: CoCascade+
candidates.working_definition: Sequential secondary exposures from an upstream pattern
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Trace multi-hop provenance; reject double-counted source families

candidates.label: CoDampen+
candidates.working_definition: Bound or suppress repeated low-value spread without deleting source history
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Negative case: suppression hides correction

candidates.label: CoSourceFamily+
candidates.working_definition: Common upstream evidence origin distinct from copy count
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Multiple copies of same origin count as one family

candidates.label: CoForeTrace+
candidates.working_definition: Prospective model trajectory with explicit horizon, uncertainty and baseline
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Prospective scoring; model allowed to lose to naive baseline

candidates.label: CoRetroTrace+
candidates.working_definition: Possible backward provenance candidates in a directed graph
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Candidate upstream sources are not verified causes

candidates.label: CoBackcast+
candidates.working_definition: Work backward from a desired outcome to possible current prerequisites
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Not retrocausation; respect rights and effect gate

candidates.label: CoBranchCounterfactual+
candidates.working_definition: Model-dependent alternative when a route/assumption differs
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Causal claim remains null without identification

candidates.label: CoTimeSkewCheck+
candidates.working_definition: Separate source/observed/prediction/validity time and skew
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Reject ambiguous clock substitutions

candidates.label: CoErrorCascade+
candidates.working_definition: Propagation of an invalid assumption through apparently independent downstream nodes
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Independent falsifier reveals inherited fault

candidates.label: CoCounterSpread+
candidates.working_definition: Propagation of corrections/dissent with source and timing
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Dissent must survive fan-in

candidates.label: CoQuarantineEdge+
candidates.working_definition: Explicitly bounded non-effect / review-only relation where evidence or rights fail
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Disallowed receiver remains unmodified

candidates.label: CoReseedDormancy+
candidates.working_definition: Dormant pattern with evidence-triggered requalification rather than always-on broadcast
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: No wake on repeated stale content

candidates.label: CoContagionGauge+
candidates.working_definition: Separate activity, independent proof, useful effects, error and cost trails
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Null benefit must not become 0 or green

candidates.label: CoSpreadPressure+
candidates.working_definition: Receiver/load pressure and attention cost associated with spread
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Pace instead of turbo on weak evidence

candidates.label: CoContagionBrake+
candidates.working_definition: Stop/rollback/repair when proof, privacy or capacity fail
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: No unauthorized effect from source document

candidates.label: CoCrossSubstrateLoss+
candidates.working_definition: Loss ledger when a source is translated into another medium/discipline
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Detect mismatched meaning/authority after translation

candidates.label: CoPatternSeren+
candidates.working_definition: Unexpected adjacency generates a challenged question, not a proven relationship
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Baseline random questions versus blind reviewer utility

candidates.label: CoOVPPropagationClosure+
candidates.working_definition: Package a bounded full-task context and successor trail rather than a broken isolated excerpt
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Cold reconstruction check and required role coverage

candidates.label: CoTume+
candidates.working_definition: User-proposed spelling; possible temporal/tuning relation; no established semantic definition found
candidates.discriminator_or_falsifier: Must recover intended meaning and check CoLex collisions before mapping

cross_surface_targets.CoSpeedo+: Read-only event/data adapter candidate; separately report activity, independent source families, verified benefit, counter-needle and time; never substitute simulation for a live feed
cross_surface_targets.CoOomph+: Pacing advice only until independent evidence/rights/budget; no automated acceleration
cross_surface_targets.CoObject+/OVP+: Preserve work-id, object rights, closure, lineage, reconstruction and selected head; no global eager graph broadcast
cross_surface_targets.CoPriMath+: Typed candidate edges and temporal relations; no source ontology or causality promotion
cross_surface_targets.CoTime+: Source, observation, validity, forecast and event times never silently collapsed
cross_surface_targets.CoQuestionCommons+: Version candidate questions, rivals, counterexamples and next discriminating tests
